# features/glossary

**Purpose:** `/glossary` index + `/glossary/[slug]` term pages.

**Entry:**

- `ui/GlossaryPage.tsx` — index listing.
- `ui/GlossaryTermPage.tsx` — individual term page.
- `ui/GlossaryNavSection.tsx` — glossary-only nav variant.

**Data:** `data/glossary-data.ts` (generated, ~689KB, tracked) regenerated by `node scripts/update-glossary.js` from `data/glossary-source.csv`.

**Belongs:** term rendering, glossary navigation.

**Does NOT belong:** other static content pages.
